title: Zaikhal Advance Camp
subtitle: Guruk Smasher spawns for Kushuk's kill task

notes.title: Smasher count and respawn
notes.body: 19 Smashers are placed here, each from a 5-minute generator, so one pass gives 19 and you need about two passes for 40 kills.

notes.title: Best element
notes.body: Frost and piercing weapons do the most damage to Guruk Smashers (cold 90%, pierce 95%). Avoid acid (10%) and lightning (40%).

notes.title: Spores
notes.body: 58 Spores patches (20 slash and bludgeon damage a second) are spread over the middle levels. Mild, but they add up in long fights.

notes.title: Boss and exit
notes.body: A Morgluuk warrior boss spawns near the bottom at (19, -121). The Portal to Burun Fortress on the lowest level leads out of the camp.
